metaDescription: Order custom adult blankets for your next promotion. Soft fleece, sherpa, and throws perfect for corporate gifts. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Adult-sized blankets offer generous coverage for cozy evenings at home, outdoor events, or office lounges. Unlike smaller youth blankets, adult options like the Sherpa Blanket or Foxhill Throw provide full-body warmth and a premium feel. Customize with your logo using embroidery or screen printing for a promotional item that recipients will use for years. Perfect for corporate gifts, employee rewards, or trade show giveaways.
